pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: app/admin/accessGate.ts:54 No test pins the cookie read by name. The only test that reaches the served branch (lib/testing/adminRouteHeaders.test.ts:11) replaces next/headers with a fake jar whose get() returns ADMIN_TOKEN for any name, and submitAdminToken (gateActions.ts) has no test at all, so a cookie-name or write/read mismatch between the sign-in action and this read would stay green while every real operator is locked out.

techniques.evidence: lib/testing/adminRouteHeaders.test.ts:11 The injected cookie-jar fake ignores its key argument, so it says 'satisfied' for any cookie name. This forks on the identity axis the technique names. If accessGate.ts:54 read the wrong cookie, the 200/no-store test would still pass. The technique's rule is to give the fake no default.

app/admin/accessGate.ts:55 The gate verdict was lifted out from behind cookies() into a pure decideAdminGate, and all four verdicts are tested in lib/security/adminGate.test.ts. Adoption at the call site is exercised through loops.GET by both route tests, but only for the not-configured and ok verdicts.

app/admin/loops.json/route.ts:4 The machine document is asserted through its consumer: features/admin/loops/loopsJson.test.ts round-trips encodeLoopsDoc through parseLoopsDoc, the same module the consumer uses to parse it.
